name: Taskly
description: Multi-board agenda: today, upcoming, calendar, map, notes and people.

meta.note: v2 REBUILD (2026-08-16, session ). Taskly is now an agenda/calendar/todo product rather than a task list: an agenda-first home with relative day headers and time-of-day ordering, month calendar, workload buckets, a long-term timeline, a map of anything with a location, per-person attribution without accounts, and an activity log. The applet id (`taskly`) and store namespace (`isan_taskly`) are UNCHANGED and must never change. The data shape moved from four private tables (tasks/notes/profiles/templates) to the shareable `entries`+`relations` graph, because the share pipeline only syncs tables literally named entries/relations/users — v1 was structurally unshareable. Old saved rows stay inert via schema_merge; a Reset gives a clean start. Identity is a per-install `tasklyMemberId` setting picked by tapping a member card (never sign-in, never $playerId); every content row's `author` is stamped `$setting:tasklyMemberId`. Date column NAMES are dictated by the engine, not by taste: toggleDone's recurrence shifts only columns literally named `scheduledStart`/`endDate`/`due`, and the host's ICS-import menu item calls importIcs with no column overrides so it writes those same default names — a column called `date` would silently break both. MULTI-BOARD (2026-08-17, session ): taskly now holds SEVERAL `kind: board` roots (a personal agenda plus user-created boards like a trip board, plus any board joined from someone else's share). `tasklyCurrentBoard` (+ its `sel:` twin, written together by the Boards screen's setSetting+selectRow chain) names the board in view; every task/event/note creation path stamps BOTH a `board` column value and a `contains` edge from that same token (column = view scoping, edge = sharing scope — two mechanisms, both stamped at write time because the engine has no derived fields), and every task view filters on the pair {kind, board}. Comment/log rows and member rows deliberately carry NO board value, which keeps them out of every board-filtered view exactly as the old kind-only filter did. The setting must never be empty: an unresolved `$setting:` token fails OPEN in filters (all boards mixed) and SKIPS the link on add (an item in no board at all), so `migrateTasklyBoards` (isan lib/src/taskly_migration.dart) re-asserts it on EVERY boot, not once.
